title: One Zine Issue
description: A four-image series showing four spreads of the same handmade zine issue, preserving paper stock, glue aesthetic, marker color, and the unmistakable hand of the same zinemaker.
creative_direction: Image 01 establishes the zine's master cover — newsprint stock, type of torn scraps, glue halos, marker palette. Images 02-04 depend on 01 so that every subsequent spread keeps the same photocopied paper tone, cut-out letter sources, glue stain aesthetic, and the zinemaker's consistent marker pens.

generation_plan.ref_strategy: Run 01 first. Use its runtime result URL as --ref for 02-04. Queue may run 02-04 concurrently after 01 is done.
generation_plan.index_policy: Only status=done images with image.png are included in works/index.json.
